note: Google Colab GPUs mapped to video-director tiers. cu_per_hour values are approximate public figures and are UNVERIFIED: Google Colab changes them and shows the live rate in its Resources panel. Override with --cu-per-hour or manifest target.colab.cu_per_hour. speed is a multiplier on the director's per-render seconds (which assume a 24 GB-class GPU); also an unverified assumption.

T4.note: fp16 only; no bf16/fp8. Draft tier at small sizes; LTX 22B needs GGUF and may still OOM.

L4.note: 24 GB nominal (about 22.5 GiB usable): standard tier; drop to draft if it runs out of memory.
